scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm run test:quartz:check && pnpm run test:quartz && pnpm run test:validation:core && pnpm run test:artifacts && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:e2e:validation
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=${PLAYWRIGHT_PORT:-$((30000 + $$ % 10000))} playwright test e2e/production.spec.ts e2e/scene.spec.ts
scripts.test:validation:core: pnpm run test:static-server && pnpm run test:orchestrator
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && pnpm run build:home && pnpm run build:blog
scripts.build:blog: corepack pnpm --dir blog/quartz quartz build --directory content --output ../../dist/blog
scripts.build:fixture: rm -rf .test-artifacts/quartz-fixture && corepack pnpm --dir blog/quartz quartz build --directory ../../tests/fixtures/quartz-content --output ../../.test-artifacts/quartz-fixture
